thread:
maria: urgent — TLS regression observed in model-serving after cert rotation in eu-west1. 2xx -> intermittent 5xx on inference endpoints. hotfix branch ready (v1.2.3-hotfix). request: expedited approval for a 30m change window to roll canary and pin. @kevin @olivia please +1?

olivia: saw the same alerts. agree to expedite. prefer region-scoped pin to eu-west1 first.

kevin: infra check complete. config diff looks minimal. set canary 10% for 15m, abort if 5xx >= 0.5%. I can watch the routing change.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot created release v1.2.3-hotfix by maria. Canary plan: cluster=redwood-eu-serving-1, traffic=10%, duration=15m, abort_threshold=0.5% 5xx. Runbook: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/eu-tls-hotfix.

jen: oncall approved. @sara FYI on cert chain fix — any security blockers?

sara: no KMS or key rotation required, just replacing intermediate cert. LGTM from sec.

matt: starting canary now. issuing pin command: `redwoodctl pin model-serving v1.2.3-hotfix --region eu-west1 --canary 10%`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary cb-493 started at 1712349999. health: initial checks passing. metrics streaming -> https://metrics.internal/d/redwood-eu/cb-493

olivia: enabling token-level traces for canary to debug any malformed TLS handshakes. muting low-priority alerts to reduce noise.

matt: noticed a spike on host eu-3 ~2m into canary: 5xx up to 2.3% for 30s. pausing rollout to investigate.

kevin: pausing propagation. pulling logs from eu-3: `journalctl -u inference | tail -n 200` showed repeated TLS handshake timeouts to upstream. might be flaky NIC after cert reload.

maria: agree pause. rollback criteria triggered? current 5xx avg across canary is 0.35% (below 0.5) but eu-3 outlier is concerning. propose: remove eu-3 from canary pool and continue. anyone object?

olivia: ok with removing node and continuing. I'll cordon eu-3 and re-run health checks.

matt: cordon done: `k8s drain eu-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`. re-evaluating health — 5xx back to 0.05%.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary cb-493 health ok after node removal. elapsed 18m. metrics show stable latencies and 5xx below threshold.

kevin: infra final approver here — give green to roll to 100% in eu-west1, then monitor for 30m before global sync.

jen: work hours team approves. maria, proceed when ready.

maria: rolling to 100% now. command: `redwoodctl rollout model-serving v1.2.3-hotfix --region eu-west1 --to 100% --strategy=gradual`

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started. target region eu-west1. estimated completion 10m.

olivia: keep traces on for another 20m; I'll watch error budget and regressions.

matt: rollout completed. post-roll checks: 5xx=0.04%, p95 latency +5ms. no error budget burn.

maria: update release notes and pin in repo. changelog: "fix: restore TLS handshake stability after cert rotation; region-scoped hotfix v1.2.3-hotfix". tagging for follow-up postmortem if anything.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: release v1.2.3-hotfix closed. canary cb-493 -> success. event id ev-2023171234.

jen: recording expedited approval: approved by jen, kevin, olivia, sara. moving to post-release monitoring for 24h. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks everyone. will open a short postmortem doc if we see recurrence, otherwise we'll close in 24h.
